name: Shared agent toolkit
tagline: The guardrails and helpers every one of my agents runs on.
summary: A small set of shared pieces that all my agents use: a privacy scanner that blocks personal data before any tool call, an auto-save helper, desktop notifications, and templates that keep every agent built the same way.
problem: Each new agent needed the same safety checks and plumbing, and copying them by hand was error-prone.
how: A security scanner checks tool calls for personal data and stops on a match.
Auto-save commits work regularly so nothing is lost.
A shared notifier sends native desktop alerts.
Workflow and tool templates follow one Workflow, Agent, Tool pattern.
